result.finding: Target container OS is Debian Linux (via eclipse-temurin:8-jre base image). Application runs on Linux in containers. Windows PowerShell scripts present for Azure infrastructure setup but not for application runtime.
evidence: Dockerfile final stage: FROM eclipse-temurin:8-jre (Eclipse Temurin JRE images are Debian-based)
Dockerfile build stage: FROM maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 (also Debian-based)
Docker Compose gvenzl/oracle-free:latest supports both ARM64 and x86_64 Linux
azure-setup.ps1 and azure-reset.ps1: PowerShell scripts for Azure infrastructure (Windows/pwsh compatible, not app runtime OS)
README.md: Docker Desktop required (cross-platform, but containers run Linux)
values: Architecture: linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (Temurin supports both)
Development host: cross-platform (Docker Desktop for Windows/macOS/Linux)
